name: Querétaro

standard.note: Querétaro's plate is white with blue bands across the top and bottom, and the state government shield and a QR code on the right side.

plates.title: Current design (2022)
plates.fact: Querétaro's plate is white with blue bands across the top and bottom, and the state government shield and a QR code on the right side.

notes: Year 2022 comes from news of the 2022 statewide reemplacamiento (UnoTV, 2022; Excelsior). In 2024 Publimetro reported that 1 in 113 plates came out defective. The queretaro.gob.mx images found were square or portrait, not plates, and placas.queretaro.gob.mx is a login page. No special designs were found, and Querétaro did not issue World Cup plates (adn40, Apr 2026).
